newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares dip amid budget uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares dip amid budget uncertainty.

text.p: Delhi shares dipped in afternoon trade on Tuesday on selective profit-taking and scattered selling induced by uncertainty over the federal budget, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange sensitive index dipped 1.16 points to 799.18 at 12:45 p.m. (0715 GMT).

"It seems that major players including foreign institutional investors are waiting for the budget to get passed in parliament before finalising their strategy," said Sushil Singhal of brokers Share Point.

The tax-cutting budget for 1997/98 (April-March), presented by former finance minister P. Chidambaram in February, has yet to be approved by parliament, which is due to meet on Wednesday to consider it.
Bajaj Auto fell sharply, quoting six rupees down at 945.
Reliance Industries quoted 0.65 rupee down at 303.75.
State Bank of India fell 1.65 rupees to 314.80.
Larsen and Toubro dropped 1.10 rupees to 225.35.
